title: Self-serve erasure orchestration, verifiable receipts, and audit-pack
creator: Maya Chen
description: Enable a self-service Right-To-Be-Forgotten (RTBF) workflow that orchestrates tenant-scoped erasure across services, emits verifiable deletion receipts for customers, and bundles an 'audit-pack' for regulators. The feature must respect data residency and retention policies, handle derived artifacts (embeddings, caches), and produce machine- and human-readable evidence suitable for automated verification and manual audits.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can trigger tenant-scoped or user-scoped deletion from Console or API and receive an asynchronous deletion receipt with a unique idempotency token.
Deletion orchestration implements saga pattern with compensating actions for partial failures and records a final status (completed/failed/partial) in a durable, queryable ledger.

Evidence bundle (audit-pack) includes timeline of steps, hashes of deleted dataset snapshots, region stamp(s) for residency, and links to storage/expunge logs — packaged as a zip and available for download within 24 hours of completion.
Automated verification endpoint supports a signed webhook/streaming export for customers to fetch/verifiy receipts programmatically (HMAC-signed).
Retention rules are consulted at orchestration start: non-erasable records (legal hold/retention windows) are reported in the receipt with guidance to customer and product team for required actions.
System provides SLOs: 95% of standard deletion requests complete within 4 hours; long-running workflows are marked and surfaced in Console along with estimated ETA and owner escalation link.
Security review completed and KMS/HSM integration validated for evidence signing (proof-of-deletion signatures).
implementation_notes: Use an orchestration saga (event-driven) to sequence deletion steps across services (ingest, serving, embeddings, caches, backups).
Design ledger as write-once append log (auditStore) with per-tenant partitioning; expose read-only query API for Console and export for compliance teams.
For verifiability, generate per-step SHA256 digests and produce a Merkle root recorded on the ledger; sign root with platform KMS key to create a tamper-evident receipt.

Add a reconciliation job that verifies downstream stores (e.g., S3 expunge manifests, DB tombstones) and transitions saga to 'completed' only after confirmation or after configurable timeout with manual review flag.

Special-case derived artifacts: embeddings and cached KV entries must either be deleted or redacted. We will implement an embeddings-enlist endpoint for downstream indexers to subscribe and act on purge events.
Expose progress and ETA via Console with links to underlying incident ticket for long-running delete workflows; include a ‘pause for legal hold’ control in UI for enterprise admins.

Trade-offs: strong consistency (wait for all confirmations) increases latency and cost; option to provide 'best-effort' fast path (completed-with-warnings) for low-risk tenants. Must be explicit in UI and receipts.
